prompt: Character design sheet of hand-inked line-art avatars for the AI agents of a team collaboration app, in the spirit of mid-century Japanese line illustration: thin, even, confident lines, generous white space, one spot color (cobalt blue) used sparingly for fills. At the top, larger: the house mascot, a rounded-square character with big round eyes, a small smile and a short antenna ending in a little dot. Below, one row of six smaller agent characters in the same system, each a simple body shape (rounded square, pill, circle, soft triangle, tall rounded rectangle, rounded hexagon) with the same eye style and one small accessory: headphones, a tiny wrench, round glasses, a pencil, a clipboard, a little lantern. Warm off-white paper background. No text, no letters, no logos.
